He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]]. ==High school career== Whitney attended [[Eric Solorio Academy High School]] for his freshman year.{{citation needed|date=April 2019}} Following his freshman year, Whitney transferred to [[Roselle Catholic High School]] in [[Roselle, New Jersey]] for the remainder of his high school career. As a senior, Whitney averaged 19.4 points, 5.7 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.1 steals per game and led Roselle Catholic to a 28–4 record. He was named a [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] and was named co-MVP of the Iverson Classic after scoring a game-high 38 points.{{cite news |last1=Fisher |first1=Chris |title=Kahlil Whitney impresses at Nike Skills Academy |url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/Article/Kentucky-basketball-Freshman-Kahlil-Whitney-impressing-at-Nike-Skills-Academy-134341788/ ==Professional career== ===Greensboro Swarm (2021)=== After going undrafted in the [[2020 NBA draft]], Whitney signed an [[Exhibit 10]] deal with the [[Charlotte Hornets]].{{cite news|first=Chris|last=Fisher|title=Kahlil Whitney signs with Hornets|url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/Article/Kentucky-basketball-Kahlil-Whitney-signs-with-Charlotte-Hornets-155113604/|work=247 Sports|date=November 21, 2020|access-date=November 22, 2020}} He was waived at the end of training camp and added to the roster of the Hornets' [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Greensboro Swarm]].{{cite web|title=Greensboro Announces Roster For Single-Site In Orlando|url=https://greensboro.gleague.nba.com/news/greensboro-announces-roster-for-single-site-in-orlando/|website=NBA.com|date=January 27, 2021|access-date=January 27, 2021}} Whitney averaged 3.0 points and 1.3 rebounds per game for the Swarm in the [[2020–21 NBA G League season|G League hub season]] between February and March 2021.{{cite news|title=Kahlil Whitney: Scores nine in win|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/kahlil-whitney-scores-nine-in-win/|work=[[CBS Sports]]|date=March 7, 2021|access-date=November 2, 2021}} ===Rio Grande Valley Vipers (2021–2022)=== In October 2021, Whitney joined the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] for the [[2021–22 NBA G League season]].{{cite news|first=Amanda|last=Atwell|title=RGV Vipers finalize training camp roster|url=https://www.valleycentral.com/sports/local-sports/rgv-vipers-finalize-training-camp-roster/|work=Valley Central|date=October 25, 2021|access-date=November 2, 2021}} ===Newfoundland Growlers (2022)=== On April 21, 2022, Whitney signed with the [[Newfoundland Growlers (basketball)|Newfoundland Growlers]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League|CEBL]].{{cite web|title=Growlers Sign Former Kentucky Forward Kahlil Whitney|url=https://www.cebl.ca/growlers-sign-former-kentucky-forward-kahlil-whitney|website=CEBL.ca|date=April 21, 2022|access-date=April 21, 2022}} ===Return to Rio Grande Valley (2022–2023)=== In November 2022, Whitney re-joined the Rio Grande Valley Vipers for the [[2022–23 NBA G League season]].{{cite web|title=Vipers Finalize 2022-23 Opening Night Roster|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/vipers-finalize-2022-23-opening-night-roster/n-5895553|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=November 3, 2022|access-date=November 3, 2022}} He was waived on January 28, 2023.{{cite web|title=2022-23 NBA G League Transactions|url=https://gleague.nba.com/22-23-nba-g-league-transactions|website=NBA.com|access-date=January 28, 2023}} ===Indios de San Francisco (2023)=== In May 2023, Whitney had a four-game stint with [[Indios de San Francisco de Macorís|Indios de San Francisco]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Baloncesto]].{{cite web|title=Kahlil Whitney|url=https://basketball.australiabasket.com/player/Kahlil-Whitney/497926|website=australiabasket.com|access-date=May 23, 2024|url-access=subscription}} ===Freseros de Irapuato (2023)=== In September 2023, Whitney joined the [[Freseros de Irapuato]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Baloncesto Profesional]] (LNBP) in Mexico.{{cite news|url=https://deportedigital.mx/debuta-walter-mccarty-con-freseros-de-irapuato-con-dura-derrota-ante-halcones-rojos|title=Debuta Walter McCarty con Freseros de Irapuato con dura derrota ante Halcones Rojos|work=DeporteDigital.mx|date=September 12, 2023|access-date=March 6, 2024|language=es}} He recorded 15 points in his team debut, a loss to the [[Halcones Rojos Veracruz]]. ===Windy City We have waived Derrick Favors and Kahlil Whitley.|number=1714657733255778518|user=chicagobulls|date=October 18, 2023|access-date=October 24, 2023}} On November 9, he joined the [[Windy City
